name: Total Reviews
query: SELECT count(topic_name) AS "COUNT(topic_name)" FROM public.topicwithname WHERE time_of_execution IN ('13th Jan 2025', '26th Dec 2024', '31st Jan 2025', '4th Feb 2025') LIMIT 50000;

name: WeekOverWeek
query: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('week', at) AS at, count(topic_name) AS "COUNT(topic_name)" FROM public.topicwithname WHERE time_of_execution IN ('13th Jan 2025', '26th Dec 2024', '31st Jan 2025', '4th Feb 2025') AND at >= TO_TIMESTAMP('2025-01-04 00:00:00.000000', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.US') AND at < TO_TIMESTAMP('2025-02-04 00:00:00.000000', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.US') GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('week', at) LIMIT 50000;

name: MonthOverMonth
query: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', at) AS at, count(topic_name) AS "COUNT(topic_name)" FROM public.topicwithname WHERE time_of_execution IN ('13th Jan 2025', '26th Dec 2024', '31st Jan 2025', '4th Feb 2025') AND at >= TO_TIMESTAMP('2024-11-04 00:00:00.000000', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.US') AND at < TO_TIMESTAMP('2025-02-04 00:00:00.000000', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.US') GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', at) LIMIT 50000;

name: Review Category Distribution
query: SELECT topic_name AS topic_name, subtopic_name AS subtopic_name, count(topic_name) AS "COUNT(topic_name)" FROM public.topicwithname WHERE time_of_execution IN ('13th Jan 2025', '26th Dec 2024', '31st Jan 2025', '4th Feb 2025') GROUP BY topic_name, subtopic_name LIMIT 10000;

name: Topics by Country
query: SELECT country AS country, count(topic_name) AS "COUNT(topic_name)" FROM public.topicwithname WHERE time_of_execution IN ('13th Jan 2025', '26th Dec 2024', '31st Jan 2025', '4th Feb 2025') GROUP BY country LIMIT 10000;

name: Topics Detected
query: SELECT topic_name AS topic_name, count(topic_name) AS "COUNT(topic_name)" FROM public.topicwithname WHERE time_of_execution IN ('13th Jan 2025', '26th Dec 2024', '31st Jan 2025', '4th Feb 2025') GROUP BY topic_name ORDER BY "COUNT(topic_name)" DESC LIMIT 1000;

name: Subtopic Detected
query: SELECT subtopic_name AS subtopic_name, count(subtopic_name) AS "COUNT(subtopic_name)" FROM public.topicwithname WHERE time_of_execution IN ('13th Jan 2025', '26th Dec 2024', '31st Jan 2025', '4th Feb 2025') GROUP BY subtopic_name ORDER BY "COUNT(subtopic_name)" DESC LIMIT 1000;

name: Topic trend with Time
query: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('day', at) AS at, topic_name AS topic_name, count(topic_name) AS "COUNT(topic_name)" FROM public.topicwithname JOIN (SELECT topic_name AS topic_name__, count(topic_name) AS mme_inner__ FROM public.topicwithname WHERE time_of_execution IN ('13th Jan 2025', '26th Dec 2024', '31st Jan 2025', '4th Feb 2025') AND at >= TO_TIMESTAMP('2024-11-04 00:00:00.000000', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.US') AND at < TO_TIMESTAMP('2025-02-04 00:00:00.000000', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.US') GROUP BY topic_name ORDER BY mme_inner__ DESC LIMIT 25) AS series_limit ON topic_name = topic_name__ WHERE time_of_execution IN ('13th Jan 2025', '26th Dec 2024', '31st Jan 2025', '4th Feb 2025') AND at >= TO_TIMESTAMP('2024-11-04 00:00:00.000000', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.US') AND at < TO_TIMESTAMP('2025-02-04 00:00:00.000000', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.US') GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('day', at), topic_name ORDER BY "COUNT(topic_name)" DESC LIMIT 10000;

name: Country to Issues
query: SELECT country AS country, subtopic_name AS subtopic_name, count(subtopic_name) AS "COUNT(subtopic_name)" FROM public.topicwithname WHERE time_of_execution IN ('13th Jan 2025', '26th Dec 2024', '31st Jan 2025', '4th Feb 2025') GROUP BY country, subtopic_name LIMIT 10000;

name: Operator to Basis
query: SELECT base_app_name AS base_app_name, subtopic_name AS subtopic_name, count(subtopic_name) AS "COUNT(subtopic_name)" FROM public.topicwithname WHERE time_of_execution IN ('13th Jan 2025', '26th Dec 2024', '31st Jan 2025', '4th Feb 2025') GROUP BY base_app_name, subtopic_name LIMIT 10000;
